snippet.title: CORDURA DEV LOG | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
CORDURA is a high-fidelity cooperative horror experience where your communication becomes your worst enemy. In this exclusive gameplay devlog, discover the Mimic, a terrifying system that utilizes real-time player voice synthesis to replicate your teammates' voices, breaking group trust and turning routine tactical missions into psychological chaos. CORDURA is a co-op psychological horror game where coordination is the only way to survive the stalking darkness that mimics your team. Communicate using proximity voice chat, but be careful: The Night listens to every word and noisy step. Face unpredictable procedural maps, collecting the Roses of the Night, and escape before paranoia turns your allies into your worst nightmare.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4414560/
Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/10018727
Discord: https://discord.gg/sfqeACkVkT
Twitter: https://x.com/playcordura---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
